name: Cleansing Cascade
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-14: The Tomb Between Worlds
description: The ritual power in this room, corrupted by necromantic energy, slams purifying water into all "unclean" creatures that try to leave.
disable: DC 25 Religion (expert) to ceremonially purify everyone in the room, by pouring water from a tub over their hands, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract the corrupted ritual magic.

generalAbilities.name: Purifying Blast
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature steps out of the room.

Effect Water sprays out of the tubs. Every creature in the room or within 10 feet of the doors takes (4d10+18) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 27 Reflex Saving Throw save) and the water casts 4th-rank Dispel Magic with a counteract modifier of +15 against the highest-rank spell active on each target (or all spells on a target that critically fails its Reflex save).
